english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an eerie, ghostly, or unsettling manner.

examples.english: That abandoned house is hauntingly eerie at night; even getting close to it is chilling.
examples.traditional: 嗰間廢屋夜晚陰森森咁，行近少少都令人心寒。
